newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo stock falls as buyout hopes fade.
newsitem.headline: Valeo stock falls as buyout hopes fade.

text.p: Shares in Valeo were down 3.5 percent in late trading on Monday as buyout speculation faded.
The shares were down 9.70 francs at 270 at 1445 GMT while the Paris bourse's CAC-40 index was 0.97 percent higher.

An industry sources confirmed a newspaper report that Cerus , Valeo's biggest shareholder with 28 percent of the capital and 42 percent of the voting rights, was well into buyout negotiations with CGIP.
The newspaper Les Echos said the deal would be engineered to avoid a takeover bid for Valeo by transferring Cerus's stake in Valeo to CGIP but not its 42 percent voting rights.
One market source said investors in Valeo were angry that shareholders' interests were being dismissed in the effort to ensure that the car parts manufacturer remained in French hands.

The stock began rising in February, in part on the company's good results and prospects, but also on buyout speculation triggered by Cerus's announcement that it was open to offers for its stake in Valeo.
